opts: log β / n → −D(P||Q) (the error exponent is the KL divergence)
exp: Stein's lemma: for fixed type-I error α < 1, the optimal type-II error satisfies lim (1/n) log β_n = −D(P||Q). The KL divergence is the optimal error exponent for hypothesis testing—a fundamental result connecting information theory and statistics.
